title: Kaytee Ultimate Birder's Blend Food, Wild Bird Seed for Outside Feeders, Grosbeaks, Cardinals, Nuthatches, Woodpeckers & More, 10 Pounds

reviews.title: Expensive, but birds love it!
reviews.body: Yeah, this bag of seed is a bit pricey, but I mixed it with some dried meal worms, and the birds and squirrels go absolutely crazy for it.  Seriously, I put a scoop of it in the feeder out in the back, and within 10 minutes it's swarming with squirrels, Blue Jays, and even an occasional chipmunk.  The Mourning Doves also love it, along with some black bird with some fancy orange stripes on its face.  I'm not sure what kind of bird it is, but it's quite the fan of this seed lol.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 6, 2026
reviews.author: Erik Drake

reviews.title: Great bag size, happy birds
reviews.body: I never thought I’d have opinions about bird seed, but here we are. 😂 This mix has been a huge hit in our backyard! The cardinals, finches, chickadees, woodpeckers, and even our three faithful hummingbirds (at their own feeder, of course) keep the yard busy all day. Very little waste, great size bag, plenty of happy birds, and free entertainment while I enjoy my morning coffee on the back porch. I’d definitely buy it again! 🐦☕🌻
